title: Embedding-Based Educational Taxonomies
abstract: arXiv:2610.33694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Educational taxonomies organize educational content, such as exercise problems, into concepts, which are also called skills or knowledge components. These taxonomies define learning objectives in educational applications such as intelligent tutoring systems. Developed through human expertise and iterative refinement, they also provide fundamental structure for curricula, assessment, and models of student learning. Recent advances in semantic text embeddings make it possible to construct alternative educational taxonomies computationally from the content itself. In this paper, we investigate this possibility by clustering embeddings of math questions to construct embedding-based educational taxonomies. translated_title: 基于嵌入的教育分类法
translated_abstract: 教育分类法将教育内容（如练习题）组织成概念，这些概念也被称为技能或知识组件。这些分类法在智能辅导系统等教育应用中定义学习目标。它们通过人类专业知识和迭代完善而开发，同时也为课程、评估以及学习者模型提供了基础结构。语义文本嵌入领域的最新进展使得从内容本身以计算方式构建替代性教育分类法成为可能。在本文中，我们通过对数学题目的嵌入进行聚类来构建基于嵌入的教育分类法，从而研究这一可能性。我们在两个ASSISTments数据集中将这些分类法与现有的基于共同核心州立标准（CCSS）的知识组件分类法进行比较，并在深度知识追踪这一依赖分类法的下游任务中评估它们的效用。
tldr: 本文提出通过对数学题目文本嵌入进行聚类来构建基于嵌入的教育分类法，并与基于共同核心州立标准的知识组件分类法进行对比，在深度知识追踪任务中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes constructing embedding-based educational taxonomies by clustering math question embeddings, comparing them with existing CCSS-based knowledge-component taxonomies, and evaluating their utility in Deep Knowledge Tracing.
